title: Quanta Services, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30, cash was USD 506.4 million, debt was USD 6.105 billion, goodwill was USD 7.869 billion, and shares outstanding were 150.27 million.
summary: Quanta's unchanged Q2 Form 10-Q confirms strong growth and cash conversion but material acquisition and funding exposure: debt materially exceeds cash, goodwill is substantial, receivables increased, and fixed-price, labor, collection and backlog-realization risks remain.
